input: battery pholi hui hai
escalation_reason: Swollen battery can leak, catch fire, or explode. Stop use immediately.
answer: Yaar, swollen battery serious cheez hai. Abhi charging band karo aur phone use karna bhi chhoro. Isko mat dabao, mat kholne ki koshish karo. Mujhse milne aao — swollen battery leak ya catch fire kar sakti hai.

input: screen toot gyi hai mobile ki
answer: Screen toot gayi hai? Pehle yeh check karo ke touch theek chal raha hai ya nahi. Agar touch bilkul normal chal raha hai toh fauri tempered glass laga lo takay ungli na kate aur crack na barhe. Lekin agar touch kaam nahi kar raha ya andar display pe lakeerein aa gayi hain toh poora panel change hoga. Shop pe dikha do.

input: battery buht jaldi khtm hori hai mobile ki
answer: Battery jaldi khatam hoti hai? Pehle check karo kaunsa app zyada battery le raha hai — Settings > Battery. Background apps band karo, screen brightness kam karo. Agar battery 2 saal se zyada purani hai toh replace karne ka waqt aa gaya hai. Mujhse milna, original ya achhi quality ki battery lagwao.

input: mobile paani mai gir gya haii
answer: Bohot achha kiya ke phone off rakha hai. Isko bilkul ON mat karna aur charger mat lagana. Chawal mein mat daalna — silica gel pouch ho toh theek hai, warna khuli hawa mein dry hone do. Sab se behtar yeh hai ke mujhe check karwao takay andar se board khol kar dry aur saaf kiya jaye, warna 2-3 din baad corrosion se phone dead ho sakta hai.

input: mobile buht zaada garam hora hai
answer: Mobile bohot garam ho raha hai toh pehle check karo: dhoop mein toh nahi rakha? Heavy apps ya gaming band karo aur mota back cover hata do. Lekin agar bina use kiye ya standby pe bhi bohot garam ho raha hai, toh foran power off karo aur mujhe dikhao — yeh battery ya motherboard IC ka short-circuit ho sakta hai.

input: laptop buht zada heating krra hai
answer: Laptop overheating ka aksar matlab hai fan ke andar dust jam gaya hai. Laptop ke neeche se hawa nahi aa rahi? Flat surface pe mat rakhna — kitaab pe rakh lo. Theek se theek karne ke liye mujhse milna, fan saaf karna padega. Khud mat kholna agar pehle kabhi nahi kiya.

input: screen toot gayi touch kaam nahi kar raha
answer: Touch kaam nahi kar raha matlab screen assembly complete damage hai. Replace karni padegi. Pehle mujhse pooch lo — phone ke model ke hisaab se price alag hota hai. Kuch phones mein screen replace karna worth it hai, kuch mein nahi.

input: Paani mein gira, screen toot gayi, touch kaam kar raha hai
escalation_reason: Powering on water-damaged device risks short-circuit damage.
answer: Agar phone abhi on hai aur paani gira hai toh FORAN power off karo. Chawal mein rakhne ki ghalti bilkul mat karna — chawal se moisture nahi nikalta balke starch port ko kharab karta hai. Charger mat lagana. SIM tray nikaal kar hawa mein rakho aur foran shop le aao takay ultrasonic cleaning se board bach jaye.

input: Fell in water, dried with hairdryer, now charging
escalation_reason: Charging a water-exposed device risks catastrophic motherboard short-circuit and component burn.
answer: Paani girne ke baad charger lagana sakht khatarnaak hai! Hairdryer ya dhoop se paani mukammal khushk nahi hota, balke moisture ICs ke neeche trapped rehta hai. Charger lagane se motherboard foran short-circuit ho kar jal sakta hai. Abhi charger foran nikalo, phone bilkul on mat karo, aur shop le aao takay proper chemical wash (isopropyl) ho sakay.

input: Phone fire pakad raha hai
escalation_reason: Smoke or burning smell indicates internal failure risk. Power off immediately.
answer: Agar dhuan ya jalane ki smell aa rahi hai toh abhi power off karo. Charger se nikalo. Mujhe call karo. Yeh wait karne wali cheez nahi hai.

input: I am frustrated, my phone hangs
answer: Slow phone ke liye pehle yeh try karo: storage full toh nahi? Gallery aur WhatsApp files clear karo. Apps uninstall karo jo use nahi karte. Factory reset se pehle mujhse baat karo — zyada tar slow phones storage se theek hote hain.

input: screen has purple ink spots but touch works
rule_label: Screen internal damage — purple ink / lines / bleeding
answer: Screen pe purple ya black ink bleed ya colored lakeerein aa rahi hain toh yeh andar ka OLED/display matrix rupture hone ki nishani hai. Touch chal bhi raha ho toh yeh aahista aahista poori screen ko 24 ghante mein black out kar dega. Fauri apna zaroori data aur WhatsApp backup le lo pehle, aur phir display panel replace karwane le aao.

input: phone is not charging
answer: Pehle check karo: doosra cable try karo, doosra adapter try karo. Charging port mein dust toh nahi? Toothpick se slowly saaf karo. Agar phir bhi nahi ho raha toh zyada tor nahi — mujhse milna, port replace ho sakta hai.
